body:
We retain a direct audit of Repeating unit 1: five exact counted-range models, 11 fresh Spectrum ROM body-placement runs, and independent learner/assessor sheets. Earlier zero/one/three-pass results remain labelled earlier evidence.

The shared notation specification now makes the existing introductory FOR convention explicit: fixed whole-number bounds, increment by one, inclusive non-empty ranges, and zero body visits when the start is past the end. Target steps, counter lifetime and loop-entry rules retain their own contracts.

Validation: a shortened exclusive-end native variant is rejected with a nonzero exit; wrong source hashes and missing transcripts are rejected; 106 local links and all 34 evidence-manifest entries pass. The website build, all 237 tests and six desktop/narrow keyboard groups pass, with no scoped axe violations or incompletes. Ruff, Vale and whitespace checks pass. The initial browser-context harness failure is retained separately from the passing run.

No learner trial, other BASIC dialect, physical device, screen-reader, audio or live-publication qualification is claimed. Parent #114/#115/#124 remain open. Next proposed slice: Basics unit 3’s output-joining and target separator contracts.

Lesson and browser verifier: https://github.com/code198x/website/pull/757 .
title: Verify counted-loop boundaries and repeated work
